Advertisement View all journals Saved research Search Account Log in Content Explore content About the journal Publish with us Subscribe Sign up for alerts RSS feed nature nature water comments article Comment Published: 16 October 2026 Risk-financing systems must adapt to a changing hydrological reality Yannick Glemarec ORCID: orcid.org/0000-0002-8530-1413 1 & Fabienne Babinsky ORCID: orcid.org/0009-0002-2438-2341 2 Nature Water ( 2026 ) Cite this article Save article View saved research 85 Accesses Metrics details Hydrological extremes are intensifying faster than risk-financing systems can adapt, pushing vulnerable countries towards a resilience trap. Closing the financial protection gap for water-related disasters will require action across four areas: anticipation, inclusion, prevention and mutualization.
